steps.title: Access Figma Developer Dashboard
steps.purpose: Establish application identity and access developer credentials.
steps.whereToGo: https://www.figma.com/developers/api > "Figma App > Account Settings > Security / Developer > OAuth apps"
steps.instructions: Navigate to https://www.figma.com/developers/api. Sign in and go to: "Figma App > Account Settings > Security / Developer > OAuth apps".
steps.howToVerify: Confirm browser loads the developer dashboard at "Figma App > Account Settings > Security / Developer > OAuth apps".

steps.title: Register New OAuth Application in Figma
steps.purpose: Registers your client identity with the authorization server.
steps.whereToGo: https://www.figma.com/developers/api > "Figma Settings > Security > "OAuth apps" > "Create a new app""
steps.instructions: Click "Figma Settings > Security > "OAuth apps" > "Create a new app"". Complete the registration form fields: App name, Website URL, Callback URL.
steps.expectedOutcome: Application created in developer console. Client ID is generated.
steps.howToVerify: Verify application entry appears in dashboard with generated Client ID.

steps.title: Configure Authorized Redirect URIs
steps.purpose: Prevents authorization code interception by locking callbacks to your server.
steps.instructions: In the redirect settings, enter your callback URL (e.g. "http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback/figma"). Note rule: Must match registered callback URL exactly. Figma rejects redirects with unlisted query parameters or ports.. Save changes.
steps.howToVerify: Confirm saved redirect URI appears under whitelisted callbacks with exact matching protocol.

steps.title: Select Permission Scopes & Secure Client Secret
steps.purpose: Configures granular API access permissions and obtains server credentials.
steps.instructions: Retrieve your Client ID and generate your Client Secret. Supported scopes: file_read (Read design files, layers, components, and export visual assets.), file_comments:write (Post comments and feedback on design files on behalf of user.), webhooks:write (Create and manage file update webhooks for automated workflows.). Scope location rule: Scopes specified via query parameter during authorization URL generation.. Store Client Secret in backend environment variables.
steps.expectedOutcome: Client Secret securely placed in server environment.
steps.howToVerify: Verify Client Secret string is copied and referenced in server .env without exposing in client code.

steps.title: Implement Figma Authorization & Token Exchange
steps.purpose: Complete standard OAuth 2.0 (Authorization Code Grant) flow.
steps.whereToGo: Backend Callback Route & Client Auth Redirect Handler
steps.instructions: Direct users to authorization endpoint: "https://www.figma.com/oauth?client_id={CLIENT_ID}&response_type=code&redirect_uri={REDIRECT_URI}&scope=file_read%20file_comments:write". Exchange authorization code by POSTing to token endpoint: "https://www.figma.com/api/v2/oauth/token".
steps.expectedOutcome: Server receives JSON payload containing access_token, token_type: Bearer, and expiration.
steps.howToVerify: Execute test code exchange and verify response JSON has 200 OK with valid access_token.

troubleshooting.description: Redirect URI in authorization request does not match Figma developer settings.
probableCauses: Port mismatch or missing trailing slash.
troubleshooting.resolution: Check Figma Settings > Security > OAuth apps > Edit app and align the callback URL.
troubleshooting.symptom: Redirect URI in authorization request does not match Figma developer settings.
troubleshooting.diagnosis: Inspect request parameters against console configuration: Port mismatch or missing trailing slash.
troubleshooting.verification: Retry authorization request and confirm expected OAuth code or token response is returned.
troubleshooting.escalationPath: Capture provider error code and request details, excluding client secrets and access tokens, then consult Figma developer docs.
